title: Yggdrasil
description: Talk to local models, search the web, read files, and use the computers you already have. Yggdrasil is the desktop app that keeps that simple.
layoutDescription: Yggdrasil runs local models on the computers you already own, with a normal chat, web and file tools, and a desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux.
footer: A local AI control plane from Yeix.

about.headline: Your computers. Your models. A chat that just answers.
about.lead: Yggdrasil is a desktop app for Mac, Windows, and Linux. It runs models on the machines you already have, searches the web and reads files when that helps, and stays a conversation instead of a toolchain.

highlights.title: Stays on your machines
highlights.text: The daemon runs locally. The web stays off until you turn Internet on.

highlights.title: Tools without the protocol
highlights.text: Search, pages, files, shell, and git show up as status, not JSON in the reply.

highlights.title: A build for each release
highlights.text: Desktop and server packages are published from CI and listed on the download page.

shots.title: A normal chat
shots.text: Ask in plain language. Answers come back as Markdown, and a web search shows up as a short status instead of raw tool syntax.

shots.title: Models you can actually run
shots.text: See what fits this computer, install it, and let Automatic pick one that can use tools when the question needs live information.

shots.title: More than one computer
shots.text: Pair machines on your network and let a harder job use another computer you already own.

shots.title: A local API when you want one
shots.text: The same daemon speaks an OpenAI-compatible API on this machine. LAN access stays off until you turn it on.
